name: Kyoto
description: Japan's former imperial capital, where thousands of temples, shrines and lantern-lit lanes sit beneath forested hills.
image_credit: Martin Falbisoner — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Tokyo
description: A vast, neon-lit capital that balances centuries-old shrines with cutting-edge design, food and nightlife.

name: Santorini
description: Whitewashed villages cling to a volcanic caldera above the Aegean, famous for sunsets over Oia and Fira.

name: Paris
description: The French capital pairs world-class museums and architecture with café culture and riverside walks.
image_credit: Yann Caradec from Paris, France — CC BY-SA 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Bali
description: An island of terraced rice fields, Hindu temples, surf beaches and a deeply rooted wellness culture.
image_credit: Vyacheslav Argenberg — CC BY 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: New York City
description: Five boroughs of skyscrapers, museums, neighbourhood food scenes and around-the-clock energy.

name: Rome
description: Ancient ruins, Renaissance palaces and trattorias share the streets of Italy's eternal capital.

name: Dubai
description: A desert metropolis of record-breaking towers, gold souks, beach clubs and dune adventures.

name: Machu Picchu
description: The 15th-century Inca citadel set on a dramatic Andean ridge above the Urubamba valley.

name: Maldives
description: Low-lying coral atolls with turquoise lagoons, overwater villas and some of the world's clearest water.

name: London
description: Royal palaces, free museums, West End theatre and a food scene drawn from every corner of the world.
image_credit: Ilya Grigorik — CC BY-SA 3.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Barcelona
description: Gaudí's surreal architecture, Gothic lanes, tapas bars and city beaches meet on the Mediterranean.
image_credit: M McBey — CC BY 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Istanbul
description: A transcontinental city where Byzantine domes, Ottoman bazaars and ferry rides across the Bosphorus converge.

name: Amsterdam
description: Canal-ringed streets, Golden Age art and a famously relaxed cycling culture.
image_credit: Andrés Barrios — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Lisbon
description: Pastel tiled façades, hilltop viewpoints and custard tarts in Portugal's sunlit capital.
image_credit: Vitor Oliveira from Torres Vedras, PORTUGAL — CC BY-SA 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Prague
description: A fairy-tale old town of spires, cobbled squares and riverside bridges.

name: Vienna
description: Imperial palaces, coffee houses and a concert calendar steeped in classical music.

name: Venice
description: A lagoon city of canals, stone bridges and Byzantine-influenced palazzi.

name: Florence
description: The birthplace of the Renaissance, packed with frescoes, sculpture and Tuscan kitchens.
image_credit: Giorgio Galeotti — CC BY 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Marrakesh
description: A walled medina of spice souks, riads and the storyteller-filled Jemaa el-Fnaa square.
image_credit: YoTuT from United States — CC BY 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Cairo
description: The gateway to the Pyramids of Giza, with a medieval Islamic quarter and the Grand Egyptian Museum.
image_credit: Ricardo Liberato — CC BY-SA 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Cape Town
description: Table Mountain rises above beaches, vineyards and a waterfront city at the continent's tip.
image_credit: Der Berzerker from Washington, DC, USA — CC BY-SA 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Queenstown
description: An alpine adventure hub on Lake Wakatipu, ringed by the Remarkables and bungee-jump history.

name: Sydney
description: Harbour ferries, the Opera House and coastal walks linking some of the world's best city beaches.

name: Rio de Janeiro
description: Beaches, samba and granite peaks define this spectacularly sited Brazilian city.
image_credit: Rafael Rabello de Barros — CC BY-SA 3.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Buenos Aires
description: Elegant avenues, steak houses and tango halls in Argentina's passionate capital.

name: Mexico City
description: Aztec foundations, mural-covered palaces and one of the Americas' most exciting food scenes.

name: Vancouver
description: A glassy waterfront city wedged between mountains, rainforest and the Pacific.

name: Reykjavík
description: A colourful harbour capital and base for glaciers, volcanic landscapes and northern lights.

name: Edinburgh
description: A dramatic castle-topped capital of medieval closes, festivals and literary history.

name: Seoul
description: Palaces and mountain trails sit beside K-pop, kimchi kitchens and 24-hour districts.

name: Bangkok
description: Gilded temples, canal boats and street-food stalls that run late into the night.
image_credit: Ninara from Helsinki, Finland — CC BY 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Singapore
description: A garden city-state of hawker centres, futuristic skylines and efficient transit.
image_credit: Benh LIEU SONG (Flickr) — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Hong Kong
description: Vertiginous skyline, harbour ferries, dim sum and hiking trails minutes from the city.
image_credit: Benh LIEU SONG (Flickr) — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Hanoi
description: A lakeside old quarter of French-colonial façades, motorbikes and steaming bowls of phở.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City's forts, palaces and bazaars form the classic gateway to Rajasthan.

name: Agra
description: Home of the Taj Mahal, whose marble domes shift colour with the light of the day.

name: Goa
description: Palm-lined beaches, Portuguese churches and a laid-back coastal culture on the Arabian Sea.
image_credit: Vyacheslav Argenberg — CC BY 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Kerala backwaters
description: A maze of palm-fringed canals, lakes and lagoons best explored by traditional houseboat.
image_credit: Augustus Binu : flickr — CC BY-SA 3.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Udaipur
description: Lake palaces and whitewashed ghats give Udaipur its nickname, the City of Lakes.
image_credit: Geri from Biel/Bienne, Schweiz — CC BY-SA 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Phuket
description: Thailand's largest island mixes busy resort beaches with quiet coves and island hops.

name: Honolulu
description: Waikīkī's surf breaks, volcanic hikes and Polynesian culture on Oʻahu's south shore.

name: San Francisco
description: Foggy hills, the Golden Gate Bridge, cable cars and a fiercely independent food culture.

name: Copenhagen
description: Bike-friendly streets, harbour baths and a design-led restaurant scene.

name: Interlaken
description: A lakeside Alpine town between Thun and Brienz, beneath the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau.

name: Dubrovnik
description: A walled Adriatic city of limestone streets, terracotta roofs and sea-view ramparts.

name: Athens
description: The Acropolis crowns a sprawling city of ancient ruins, rooftop bars and tavernas.
image_credit: Andrew Parlette — CC BY 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Petra
description: A Nabataean city carved into rose-red sandstone cliffs, reached through a narrow gorge.

name: Jerusalem
description: A holy city for three faiths, with layered archaeology and a lively modern food scene.

name: Taipei
description: Night markets, hot springs and mountain trails surround Taiwan's compact capital.

name: Kuala Lumpur
description: Malay, Chinese and Indian food cultures meet beneath the Petronas Towers.
image_credit: Vyacheslav Argenberg — CC BY 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Kathmandu
description: A valley of stupas, durbar squares and the gateway to Himalayan trekking.
image_credit: Gerd Eichmann — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Zanzibar
description: Spice-island beaches and a Stone Town of Swahili, Arab and Indian heritage.
image_credit: Mussi Katz from Israel — Public domain — Wikimedia Commons

name: Amalfi Coast
description: Cliffside villages, lemon groves and azure water along Italy's most celebrated coastline.
image_credit: Bruno Rijsman — CC BY-SA 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Cinque Terre
description: Five pastel fishing villages linked by coastal trails above the Ligurian Sea.
image_credit: Bruno Rijsman — CC BY-SA 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Banff National Park
description: Turquoise lakes, glacier-fed rivers and Rocky Mountain trails in Canada's oldest national park.

name: Yellowstone National Park
description: Geysers, hot springs and roaming bison across the world's first national park.

name: Grand Canyon
description: A mile-deep Colorado River canyon of layered rock and immense desert vistas.
image_credit: Lennart Sikkema — CC BY 3.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Patagonia
description: Wind-battered steppe, granite spires and glaciers at the southern end of the Americas.
image_credit: Pedro Szekely from Los Angeles, USA — CC BY-SA 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Galápagos Islands
description: Volcanic islands where sea lions, tortoises and iguanas show little fear of visitors.
image_credit: Diego Delso — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Havana
description: Crumbling colonial façades, vintage cars, cigar smoke and live son cubano.

name: Cartagena
description: A walled Caribbean port of colourful balconies and Spanish fortifications.
image_credit: Pedro Szekely from Los Angeles, USA — CC BY 2.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Cusco
description: The former Inca capital, a high-altitude city of stone walls and Andean markets.

name: Auckland
description: A harbour city of volcanic cones, island ferries and nearby wine country.

name: Melbourne
description: Laneway cafés, street art and a live-music scene in Australia's cultural capital.

name: Bora Bora
description: A turquoise lagoon encircled by motu islets and a dramatic volcanic peak.
image_credit: NASA Johnson Space Center — Public domain — Wikimedia Commons

name: Seychelles
description: Granite boulders, palm forests and powder-white beaches across 115 islands.

name: Mauritius
description: Reef-protected lagoons, sugarcane fields and a melting-pot Creole culture.

name: Hội An
description: A lantern-lit trading port of yellow shopfronts, tailors and riverside markets.
image_credit: DEBA PRASAD ROY — CC0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Hạ Long Bay
description: Thousands of limestone karsts rising from emerald water in the Gulf of Tonkin.

name: Siem Reap
description: The base for Angkor's temple complex, from Angkor Wat to the jungle-clad Ta Prohm.
image_credit: Pierre André Leclercq — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Luang Prabang
description: A UNESCO-listed town of gilded temples, colonial villas and Mekong sunsets.

name: Samarkand
description: Silk Road monuments with turquoise domes and mosaic-covered madrasas.

name: Tbilisi
description: A warm, cluttered capital of sulphur baths, balconied houses and natural wine.

name: Muscat
description: Whitewashed mosques, a long corniche and rugged mountains meeting the Gulf of Oman.

name: Luxor
description: The Valley of the Kings and Karnak temple sit on the Nile's east and west banks.
image_credit: Diego Delso — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Maasai Mara
description: Savannah plains famous for the Great Migration and exceptional big-cat sightings.
image_credit: Danijel Mihajlovic — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Victoria Falls
description: The world's largest sheet of falling water, with rafting and sunset cruises on the Zambezi.
image_credit: Diego Delso — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

name: Lake Como
description: Villas, gardens and steep mountainsides reflected in one of Italy's deepest lakes.

name: Swiss Alps
description: High passes, glaciers and mountain villages linked by scenic trains and cable cars.
image_credit: Roy Egloff — CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons
